description:
A Starsector faction and content compilation for

0.98a

, Kwin’s Sector Industry Compilation adds four lore-rich corporations with unique ships, weapons, fighters, hullmods, colony Charter Offices, and specialized procurement storefronts. Build a Charter Office to partner with Zenith Era, Yunze General Ordnance, Monolith Ordnance, or Flicker Aviation, each offering distinct colony bonuses and market access, from Yunze weapon sales to Flicker aviation hardware and Monolith warships.
